provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Record Label

examples.psychological_goal: 一句假设把观众的拥有者幻想变成共同语境
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称幻想式开场（so you want to have your own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to have your own record label.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"所以你想拥有自己的X"三秒内开局
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体行业对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用"免费vs集中"的悖论一句话立起全片谜面
examples.expression_mechanism: 条件从句+集中反问的悖论句式（if X is free, why do few control Y）
examples.example_text: So, if music distribution is practically free, why do three companies still control most of the entire recorded music business?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用行业常识（免费）对撞行业事实（集中）制造好奇缺口
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体行业与数字

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句重构替换观众的整门生意心智模型
examples.expression_mechanism: 本质重定义句（X is not A, X is an investment fund in people）
examples.example_text: A record label is an investment fund. He simply invests in people, not companies
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X其实是投人而非投公司的基金"式重定义交付第一答案
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该重定义本身

examples.psychological_goal: 用创投式失败分布量化"这门生意的数学"建立可信感
examples.expression_mechanism: 组合分布数学（out of every N, most fail completely）
examples.example_text: Out of every 10 artists signed by a label, approximately 5-7 will lose money completely.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"每N个里M个亏完"的组合句式量化风险分布

examples.psychological_goal: 用设问把叙事从"是什么"推进到"怎么做"，保持章节动力
examples.expression_mechanism: 章节设问换挡（so how does X decide which Y to bet on）
examples.example_text: So how does a label decide which unknown artist to bet on?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"那么X如何决定Y"的设问开启机制章节
examples.negative_instruction: 换挡后必须在当章给出机制答案

examples.psychological_goal: 先排比三连"零转化"再用两字判词收束，制造反直觉顿悟
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连排比+对仗判词（no X, no Y, no Z. this is noise, not a signal）
examples.example_text: No merch purchased, no concert tickets purchased, no albums listened to . This is noise, not a signal.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用排比举证后用"这是噪声，不是信号"式短判词定性

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句对仗完成"算法与人"的分工定义，机制边界一目了然
examples.expression_mechanism: 人机分工对仗（the software finds X, a person decides whether X means anything）
examples.example_text: The software finds an anomaly. A person still has to decide whether an anomaly means anything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"工具发现X，人判断X是否重要"对仗句划清机制边界

examples.psychological_goal: 阶梯累加后的总额判词，让"先出后进"的现金错配落地
examples.expression_mechanism: 累加总额+尚未开始的对照（already spent X, and Y hasn't even begun）
examples.example_text: That's $140,000 already spent, and the song has n't even been released yet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习逐笔累加后用"已经花了X而Y还没开始"收束时间线

examples.psychological_goal: 用"这不是故障，这是设计"的判词把愤怒转化为冷峻理解
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定对仗判词（this is not a system failure. this is a system）
examples.example_text: This is not a system failure. This is a system.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这不是X的失败，这就是X"式判词为机制章封顶

examples.psychological_goal: 巨星破产的具象落差（千万销量vs账户几美元）制造全片情绪低点
examples.expression_mechanism: 反差落地句（yet in YEAR, X declared bankruptcy with only a few dollars）
examples.example_text: Yet in 1998 she declared bankruptcy, reportedly with only a few dollars in her account.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"然而某年当事人破产，账上只剩几美元"为机制配上真人代价
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物与年份

examples.psychological_goal: 瀑布终点数字让"头条收入"与"实际留存"的落差一次到位
examples.expression_mechanism: 瀑布收束句（after each deduction from X, retained is usually around Y）
examples.example_text: After each of these deductions from a $10 million hit, the label's actual retained earnings are usually around $4 million
examples.usage_instruction: 学习逐层扣减后用"实留约为Y"对照头条数字X

examples.psychological_goal: 交易倍数区间把"老目录比新热门更值钱"从断言变成市场事实
examples.expression_mechanism: 估值倍数证据（have recently traded at N to M times annual revenue）
examples.example_text: Established, proven music catalogs have recently traded at prices ranging from 9 to 21 times their previous annual revenue.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"近期以年收入的N到M倍成交"为资产价值定价

examples.psychological_goal: 权力反转判词：最大的成功变成最不赚钱的资产，制造商业奇景
examples.expression_mechanism: 反讽判词（biggest success becomes least profitable asset）
examples.example_text: The label's biggest success story becomes its least profitable asset.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"最大的X变成最不赚钱的Y"表达权力反转

examples.psychological_goal: 用"诚实回答大家都在问的问题"拉起综合章，单词回答先给结论
examples.expression_mechanism: 元叙述拉升+设问+单词回答（here's the real honest answer... X? No.）
examples.example_text: So, here's the real honest answer to the question everyone is asking. Did the Internet kill the record label? No.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这是大家都在问的问题的诚实答案：X吗？不。"开启综合章
examples.negative_instruction: 拉升后必须给出本质层的综合判断

examples.psychological_goal: 行业本质定性：表面产品从来不是产品，而是诱饵
examples.expression_mechanism: 本质否定+一词判词（X has never been a product. X is a lure）
examples.example_text: Music itself has never been a marketable product. Music is a lure.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X从来不是产品，X是诱饵"完成本质层重构

examples.psychological_goal: 用对仗格言把全片压缩成可带走的一句话
examples.expression_mechanism: 对仗格言收束（X creates noise. Y is where the money really lives）
examples.example_text: Music creates noise. The catalog is where the money really lives.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X制造噪声，Y才是钱真正居住的地方"式对仗格言收尾
